summary: Live looper synced to the song, made for a MIDI controller: one Record trigger steps empty, recording, playing, overdubbing, playing; Stop, Play, Undo, Redo, Clear and Multiply (x2, x3, x4) are their own triggers. In Sync starts and stops wait for the next bar or beat and the first take is rounded to whole bars at the song tempo; in Free the first take sets the length. Feedback on overdub, input monitor, Reverse, Half speed, a crossfade at the loop point and at every punch, undo levels, and the loop's audio is saved with the song. Use it to build a loop live from a pad or footswitch.
use_for: Build a loop live from a MIDI pad or footswitch: record, overdub, multiply and undo, in time with the song's bars, with feedback, reverse and half speed.

parameters.name: Record
parameters.description: Trigger: Empty to Recording to Playing to Overdubbing to Playing (a pad or footswitch sends it)
parameters.how: Each press steps the one-button cycle: start recording, close the take and play, overdub, back to play.
parameters.sound: In Sync each step waits for the next bar or beat.

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description: Trigger: stop the loop (it is kept)
parameters.how: Stops playback at the next bar (Sync) or now (Free); the loop stays in memory.
parameters.sound: The loop ends with a short fade.

parameters.name: Play
parameters.description: Trigger: play a stopped loop from its start
parameters.how: Starts a stopped loop from its beginning at the next bar (Sync) or now (Free).
parameters.sound: The loop comes back in time with the song.

parameters.name: Undo
parameters.description: Trigger: take back the last overdub, multiply or clear
parameters.how: Goes back one level of the undo history at once.
parameters.sound: The loop returns to how it was before the last pass.

parameters.name: Redo
parameters.description: Trigger: bring back what Undo took away
parameters.how: Goes forward one level after an Undo, until you overdub or multiply again.
parameters.sound: The pass you took back returns.

parameters.name: Clear
parameters.description: Trigger: empty the loop (Undo brings it back)
parameters.how: Empties the loop; the old loop is kept as an undo level.
parameters.sound: Silence from the loop.

parameters.name: Multiply
parameters.description: Trigger: make the loop 2, 3 or 4 times as long, repeating its content
parameters.how: The loop becomes Multiply by times as long at its next start; its content repeats, so overdubs can vary over the longer cycle.
parameters.sound: The same phrase, now with room to change over a longer cycle.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Sync: starts and stops wait for the next bar or beat and the first take is whole bars; Free: the first take sets the length
parameters.how: Chooses whether the loop follows the song's bars or your own timing.
parameters.sound: Sync keeps the loop on the beat; Free lets you record any length.

parameters.name: Quantise
parameters.description: Sync: what starts and stops wait for
parameters.how: Chooses the next bar or the next beat as the landing point in Sync.
parameters.sound: Beat lets you drop in sooner, bar keeps the phrase whole.

parameters.name: Multiply by
parameters.description: How many times as long Multiply makes the loop
parameters.how: Sets the factor of the Multiply trigger.
parameters.sound: A longer cycle that repeats the take until you overdub.

parameters.name: Pedal
parameters.description: Which change of a trigger fires: the press only, or the press and the release too (a latching footswitch)
parameters.how: Chooses whether a trigger parameter fires on 0 to 1 only, or on every change.
parameters.sound: Use the second for a footswitch that stays down.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: How much of the old loop stays at each overdub pass (100 % keeps everything)
parameters.how: Scales the existing loop while an overdub pass records over it.
parameters.sound: Lower values let old layers fade away.

parameters.name: Monitor
parameters.description: The input is heard while looping
parameters.how: Passes the input to the output beside the loop.
parameters.sound: Off, you hear only the loop.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description: Play the loop backwards
parameters.how: Reads the loop from the end to the start.
parameters.sound: The phrase runs backwards.

parameters.name: Half speed
parameters.description: Play at half speed, an octave down, exactly twice as long
parameters.how: Reads the loop at half speed.
parameters.sound: An octave lower and twice as slow; an overdub made now returns an octave higher at normal speed.

parameters.name: Crossfade
parameters.description: The fade at the loop point and at every punch in and out
parameters.how: Sets the length of the crossfade that hides every edit.
parameters.sound: Short is tight, long is soft.

parameters.name: Loop level
parameters.description: Level of the loop in the output
parameters.how: Sets the playback level of the loop.
parameters.sound: Lower to tuck the loop under what you play.

parameters.name: Max loop
parameters.description: The longest loop: memory is allocated for it (changes only while the loop is empty)
parameters.how: Sets the longest loop the machine can hold, which sets its memory.
parameters.sound: Longer loops use more memory and make bigger songs.

parameters.name: Undo levels
parameters.description: How many overdub passes can be taken back (1 to 8; changes only while the loop is empty)
parameters.how: Sets the undo history depth; each level needs one more loop buffer.
parameters.sound: More levels use more memory.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the effect has no latency, so the dry signal is not delayed)
parameters.how: Blends the looper with the unprocessed sound.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep more of the live input.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: scales the loop's level against the input; 100 % = the settings as shown, 0 % = bypass (bit for bit the input)
parameters.how: Scales the loop's level: 0 % is bypass, 100 % your settings, 200 % twice the loop level.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to bring the loop in, up to push it forward.

readings.description: Looper state: 0 empty, 1 recording, 2 playing, 3 overdubbing, 4 stopped
Length of the loop in seconds
